params.negative: low quality, ugly, unfinished, out of focus, deformed, disfigure, blurry, smudged, restricted palette, flat colors

card.architecture: Chroma 8.9B (FLUX.1-schnell-derived DiT, T5-XXL only, fully open)
card.summary: Open, fully-uncensored 8.9B Flux-derived model (bf16 on 24 GB). Flux-class coherence and anatomy with no safety alignment; T5-only, real CFG + negative prompts.
use_cases: artistic and photoreal work with negative-prompt control
card.pick_when: You want Flux-level quality with no content filtering and full CFG/negative control.

prompt.guidance: Natural-language prose; T5-only so be descriptive. Real CFG (~3.8) with a negative prompt.
prompt.example: A windswept cliff at dawn, a lone figure in a red cloak facing the sea, dramatic clouds, painterly, highly detailed
prompt.instructions: Write descriptive natural language (no CLIP, T5 only). Uses real classifier-free guidance: cfg ~3.8 with a genuine negative prompt. Recommended ~26 steps, euler, beta scheduler. Min-padding tokenization (T5TokenizerOptions) is applied for you.
do: Use a negative prompt to suppress artifacts
dont: Expect CLIP-style tag prompting to be optimal
prompt.negative_guidance: Fully supported (real CFG). e.g. 'blurry, low quality, deformed, watermark, text'.

speed.measured_note: 8.9B bf16 on 24 GB; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two. Uncensored, with full control over what to avoid.
